heaviest_rainfall.status: Record amounts of rain fell over 36.8 hours today with a total accumulation of 29.53mm.  It fell at 9.4 mm per hour at times and ranked 6th from our records.  The heaviest total rainfall occurred on 09 November 2025, dropping 47.89mm of rain over the 144.8 hour storm duration with a maximum rate of 24.6mm per hour.

heaviest_rainrate.status: The rain rate reached 34.3mm per hour on 02 September 2025, and resulted in 21.19mm of rain over 15.0 hours.  This is the highest rate recorded by our weather station.

longest_rain.status: The storm today ranked 4th for the length of the storm when compared to others in our records and it lasted 36.8 hours.  29.53mm of rain fell and at one point was falling at 9.4mm per hour.  The record duration for continuous rain was set on 09 November 2025, the storm lasted 144.8 hours with a total precipitation of 47.89mm and it reached 24.6mm per hour at times.
